bio: A restaurant that exudes a sense of freedom, excitement and youthful exuberance in equal measure – qualities which combine perfectly with consistency, technique and a passion for hard work. The setting, which takes on the appearance of a bar with just a few tables and has a counter set up for dining, is relatively simple, but this is compensated in spades by contemporary cuisine featuring flavours and textures that are always interesting. Choose between an à la carte particularly designed for sharing, with the option of “raciones” and half plates....
